events.quote_anchor: She stopped, and crouched so they were face-to-face, and said, “You’re hurt.”

events.quote_anchor: “We should go,” said Mitch from the doorway.

events.did: rose slowly to his feet with a hand on Sydney's shoulder, and said he was only resting his legs

events.did: told Victor that Serena and June were dead and that Mitch was an EO now like them
events.quote_anchor: “Serena’s dead,” she said, thinking it would hurt less if she said it quick. “And so is June. And Mitch is an EO now. Like us.”

events.did: saw one man become two on cue as Mitch duplicated, and said the pills he had been given were not bullshit after all
events.quote_anchor: “Huh,” said Victor. “I guess those pills weren’t bullshit after all.”

relations.quote_anchor: She stared at the remains, gladness welling up in her, that he was gone. Finally. Forever. But Victor didn’t look as happy as she felt.

relations.did: is an EO like Sydney and Victor, and can duplicate himself
relations.quote_anchor: Victor met Mitch’s gaze, brows lifting in question, and as if on cue, one man became two.

relations.did: was told the pills were for hypertension, and Syd frowned at that account of them

relations.did: asked Victor whether the EON residents had died with Gabriel and told him Gabriel was the only thing keeping them alive
